symptom: `check` refused `nativeslider s1 (editable: 'default')` with "`Editable: default` is not an Editable value [MDL-WIDGET19]" — the form describe prints — so a native page with a slider, range slider, rating or toggle buttons could not be described and re-run
cause: those native widgets declare an `editable` enumeration of their own (default | never) and no Editability system property; exec writes `editable:` to that key (the CustomWidget's Editable stays Always), but validateConsumableConditional judged the name as the core Editable
fix: skip the core Editable value check when the widget's definition maps an `editable` key of its own; validatePluggableEnumValues judges the value against the package's keys
insight: same class as ako/mxcli#2180 (a widget's own key spelled like a core name), but `editable` is deliberately not in pages.coreNamesPluggableKeysShadow because a CustomWidget stores Editable itself — so only check was wrong; exec already wrote the own key. Dumping the stored CustomWidget (Editable: Always) settled which layer to touch
